title: signBudget
responsibility: Validates the reviewer and record behind a baseline or approval and writes the ledger event.

inputs.name: budgetEstablish.input
inputs.description: Repository, verification record, reviewer, reason, and unit selection used to establish baselines. When all is true, the workflow selects measured units without baselines; otherwise it uses units, and the reviewer and reason must be nonblank.

examples.reason: Reviewed passing verification gates before updating limits
Reviewed passing verification gates before updating limits

inputs.name: budgetApprove.input
inputs.description: Repository, verification record, reviewer, reason, and units whose baselines are being approved. Each selected unit must already have a baseline, and the reviewer and reason must be nonblank.

examples.reason: Reviewed passing verification gates before updating limits

outputs.name: budgetEstablish
outputs.description: The resolved array contains a baseline ledger event for each selected unit without an existing or inherited baseline. Each event records measured metrics, unavailable measurements when present, performance limits, and the reviewer signature.

examples.reason: Reviewed passing verification gates before updating limits

outputs.name: budgetApprove
outputs.description: The resolved array contains an approval ledger event for each explicitly selected unit, including its prior and newly measured frozen metrics. Each selected unit must already have a baseline; unavailable measurements are included when present.

examples.reason: Reviewed passing verification gates before updating limits

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised for expected validation failures, including a blank reviewer or reason, a missing or failed verification record, the record author acting as reviewer, incomplete measurements, unusable performance comparison data, an unknown unit, or a baseline state that disallows the requested event.
